basis.governing_question: Should Quinta Azul enter the retail markets of Spain, France, Germany and Poland, and in which order?

phases.name: Research
phases.objective_one_line: Assess retail attractiveness, competition and Quinta Azul's capability to win in Spain, France, Germany and Poland.

gate.label: Countries to design
gate.decision: Which of the four countries go forward into entry options design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Compare entry options per country and define the go or no-go, sequence and entry plan.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Approve the go or no-go per country, the entry sequence and the entry plan?

architect_notes: The 10 to 14 weeks is an estimate: the archetype's typical weeks, extended for four countries; confirm length and split before this becomes a quote.
